ideas.pitch: A ground station software suite that processes live manual flight logs and telemetry to calculate drop zones and wind compensation for RC aircraft payload drops.
ideas.title: AeroDrop Target Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Boeing aeromodelling challenge requirements for golf ball payload drops by providing a measurable performance advantage in drop accuracy.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight onboard data logger tracking G-forces, motor current, and altitude without violating rules against pre-programmed flight assistance.
ideas.title: WingTelemetry Edge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with hardware-focused judging criteria by offering a tangible telemetry tool that helps pilots tune their 1kg fixed-wing aircraft manually.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and weight-distribution checklist app designed to help teams pass the strict pre-flight safety inspections for wingspan and weight limits.
ideas.title: AeroInspector AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate compliance bottleneck that every team at the Boeing aeromodelling competition faces during safety check-ins.

ideas.pitch: A mechanical servo-timer release mechanism triggered safely by a manual channel, ensuring precise ball drops after the mandatory 30-second flight time.
ideas.title: PayloadRelease Actuator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the scoring metric of payload efficiency and minimum flight time compliance without using prohibited gyroscopic flight assists.

ideas.pitch: A desktop tool to parse manual flight recorder logs after landing and render a 3D flight path to review drop zone accuracy and approach angles.
ideas.title: FlightLog 3D Replay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides teams with rapid post-flight iteration capability, mimicking professional aerospace debrief tools during a high-stakes zonal selection.
